purpose: Historical reference scenario for an offline synthetic GNSS waterfall application; not a measured observation.

observatory.name: UIRAPURU reference site
observatory.elevation_convention: Treat elevation_m as WGS84 ellipsoidal height for this reference simulation.
observatory.coordinate_source: GNSSVis SkyAnalyzer defaults; not independently surveyed here.

pointing.azimuth_convention: degrees east of north; azimuth is immaterial at the zenith

beam.selection_note: The hard circular gate defines passage support. Emission has a separate Gaussian angular gain inside this gate.

receiver.occupied_bandwidth: Actual GPS modulation bandwidth is not modelled; the synthetic profile width is configured below.

geometry.comparison_frame: local unrefracted altitude/azimuth for both the pointing and satellite
geometry.timescale_data: bundled package data only; no external Earth-orientation update

passages.definition: maximal contiguous run of samples inside the beam and above the horizon
passages.exit_time_exclusive: first following excluded sample, or the observation end when clipped

randomness.reproducibility: Same seed, effective configuration, and dependency versions reproduce the generated arrays. Record versions and use stated tolerances across environments.

output.axis_dtype: float64 for frequency centers; integer UTC time offsets from start
output.power_unit: relative linear power; never sum in dB

path_rules.reference_paths: relative to the repository root, not the caller working directory
path_rules.output_directory: default from this file; an explicit CLI output override is permitted

frequency_grid.channel_placement: uniform bin centers spanning the receiver band

noise.interpretation: Equivalent power statistics of averaged independent complex Gaussian white-noise samples; no voltage waveform or FFT is required. Power pixels are not Gaussian.

emission.time_support: Only samples inside the configured beam selection gate and above the horizon.
emission.carrier_selection: Inject only nominal carrier centers inside the receiver band.
emission.combination: Add independent satellite/carrier contributions in linear relative power.
emission.calibration: Illustrative equal profile coefficients for IIF and III, not measured EIRP, dBm, or block-specific calibrated power.

display.layout: GNSSVis-style upper passage panel, lower waterfall, right-hand satellite/color table, and horizontal colorbar
display.carrier_markers: One dotted horizontal line and label per in-band nominal carrier, not duplicate lines for satellites sharing that carrier.
display.intensity_label: Relative power [dB re configured mean background]
display.shared_geometry: Use the same time grid and passage masks for synthesis and both panels.

matrix_contract.validation: Require positive grid sizes and duration_seconds to be an exact multiple of step_seconds.

column_axis.absolute_timestamp: time_grid.start_utc + time_offsets_seconds[j] seconds, interpreted in UTC

cell_values.indexing: power[i,j] is power in frequency channel i at time sample j
cell_values.storage_unit: relative linear power; same normalization for all three arrays
cell_values.display_encoding: color, not a third array dimension
cell_values.display_unit: dB relative to configured mean background power
